rec.name: Sold-Out PDP: Back-in-Stock Notify + Alternative Product Highlight
rec.status: Built (UI visible in screenshot) - duplicate ticket, no written spec

what.text: On the product page of a sold-out product, the purchase area shows a 'Back soon' status line and a full-width 'Email me when available' button. Below them is a 'How about this alternative:' heading and a horizontally scrollable product card for an in-stock alternative. The card shows an image, title, price, color swatches and a 'Discover now' button. A small round badge on the image carries a fit note ('Runs one size smaller').

why.text: A sold-out PDP is a dead end, and most visitors would otherwise bounce. The notify-me button captures the demand for a later return visit and builds an email list. The alternative gives intent-driven shoppers an immediate substitute, which keeps them in the funnel. The fit badge on the alternative reduces sizing doubt (risk reduction) when the visitor switches products. The 'Back soon' wording implies the item is only temporarily gone, which keeps the original product desirable.

how.text: Show this block only when the current product or variant is unavailable. Replace the add-to-cart button with the back-in-stock email button, which opens the notify-me app form. Below it, render a heading and a horizontal card slider. Each card is a compact product card (image, title, price, color swatches, CTA button to the product page). The next card peeks in from the right to signal it can be scrolled. The alternative is probably picked per product through a metafield or a product reference (inferred, not stated). The round badge is likely a text label on the image, possibly from a metafield.

items: Alternative product(s) to show (manual product reference or rule-based) - inferred
Heading text ('How about this alternative:' with emoji)
Optional image badge text (e.g. fit note)

dependencies.text: Back-in-stock/notify-me app or form (not named in the source). Probably a product metafield or product-list reference for alternatives. The theme needs availability logic for sold-out variants. Nothing is stated in the ticket text, so all of this is inferred.

items: Click-through rate on the alternative product card
Notify-me sign-up rate on sold-out PDPs
PDP exit/bounce rate for sold-out products
Revenue per session on sold-out PDP traffic
Add-to-cart rate on the alternative product after click-through

images.caption: Sold-out PDP: 'Back soon' status, 'Email me when available' button, 'How about this alternative' heading, and a swipeable alternative product card with a fit badge, price, swatches and CTA.
Card layout and configurable elements: image with round badge, title, price, color swatches, CTA, and a peeking next card.
